items.title: Fix worktree-authority-smoke.ts done_recover post-merge version-bump ENOENT (RED then GREEN)
items.context: assertDoneRecoverRunsPostMergeBuildForRuntimeChanges's synthetic mkdtemp root has no package.json, but done_recover now also runs bumpVersionOnDoneMerge (core/version-bump.ts) which requires root/package.json and the other version sync points to exist, throwing ENOENT before the stubbed build runner is ever reached. Write a RED script proving the current ENOENT, then fix the fixture's root scaffold to include the version sync-point files done_recover's post-merge path now needs, confirm GREEN.

happy.desc: RED script red-B-74b9-chk003-version-bump.mjs fails on the pre-fix tree with the ENOENT package.json signature

A fresh run of worktree-authority-smoke.js no longer contains the DONE post-merge version bump failed / ENOENT package.json signature (confirmed via a dedicated grep-style check). NOTE: the whole file still exits non-zero after this fix, but now ONLY due to a confirmed-unrelated, separately-tracked pre-existing bug (task_a8d49518, assertConcurrentDoneSerializesWithoutPartialDone, a concurrent DONE-lock race unmasked by fixing this ENOENT crash that used to abort the script earlier) -- verified via isolated reproduction on a clean untouched main checkout before being excluded from this items scope.

verification.command: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['packages/main/dist/tasks/worktree-authority-smoke.js'],{encoding:'utf8'});const out=(r.stdout||'')+(r.stderr||'');console.log(out.includes('DONE post-merge version bump failed before any commit')?'VERSION_BUMP_STILL_BROKEN':'VERSION_BUMP_FIX_CONFIRMED');"

edge.desc: Investigation confirmed a fixture-only fix suffices: bumpVersionOnDoneMerge/applyPatchBump reads package.json etc. from the filesystem via readFileSync (not git history), and every real Proofbound repo root always has these files by construction -- the ENOENT can only occur in a synthetic fixture root, never in real partial-DONE recovery
